overview: Consumer Complaint Quality Signal Mining addresses telemetry is noisy or missing, so operators spend time interpreting unrelated warnings in consumer packaged goods operations. The first proof of value uses contact centre claims, batch numbers and defect codes. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is time to escalate verified quality trends, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.
kpi: time to escalate verified quality trends

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: contact centre claims, batch numbers and defect codes; define time to escalate verified quality trends and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Commercial Director / Supply Chain VP.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including inject sensor failures, stale data and dependency loss into the pilot.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
